top_findings: Tool pages ship ~440 KB inline JS (530 KB HTML)
Templated meta descriptions with duplicated nouns

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS, www/http 301s, canonicals, sitemaps (Rank Math, 31 posts/321 pages/11 cats), robots.txt with AI-bot rules

findings.title: robots.txt lists /sitemap-clean.xml which returns 404
findings.recommendation: Remove the line or create the file; keep sitemap_index.xml only.

findings.title: Stray pages indexable and in sitemap
findings.description: /sample-page/ (200, in sitemap), /dog-zoomies-guide-2/ and /rabbit-grooming-guide-2/ use -2 slugs while the base slug 404s.
findings.recommendation: Delete sample-page; fix slugs to the canonical name and 301 any old URL.

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: No HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy or CSP on the homepage.

findings.title: robots.txt Disallow: /*?* blocks all query URLs
findings.recommendation: Acceptable, but confirm no needed URLs use parameters.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Blog post is deep (about 3,300 words, 15 H2s, RER formula, Person author)
Tool pages have 2,000+ words of visible text, FAQ blocks

findings.title: Templated tool pages risk thin/duplicate-pattern content
findings.description: 308 tool URLs from one renderer; meta descriptions follow a template with noun duplication: 'Free Reptile reptile feeding calculator', 'Free Cat cat hydration'.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite templated descriptions via the override system; prioritise pages with traffic.

findings.title: Homepage has about 370 words
findings.recommendation: Add intro, category explanations, trust/author signals.

findings.title: Health claims need E-E-A-T
findings.description: 'Vet-reviewed' claims on tools; verify a named reviewer exists on pages (YMYL-adjacent).
findings.recommendation: Add named vet reviewer, credentials and review dates.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles, one H1 per page, good descriptions on hand-written pages

findings.title: Homepage title and description are the same string
findings.description: Title 'petzenai - Free AI-Powered Pet Care Tools - ...' is lower-case brand and longer than 60 chars; description repeats it without the 'petzenai -' prefix.
findings.recommendation: Title: 'PetZenAI | Free Pet Care Calculators & Guides' (under 60 chars); write a distinct 150-char description.

findings.title: Two different homepage titles
findings.description: Static page title differs from the sample-page title format, showing inconsistent brand casing.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Tool pages: Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, ItemList, Person

findings.title: Homepage lacks Organization schema
findings.recommendation: Add Organization with logo and sameAs.

findings.title: FAQPage rich results restricted
findings.description: Google limits FAQ rich results to gov/health authority sites; keep it for AI citability, not SERP features.

findings.title: Tool pages are about 530 KB of HTML, 440 KB inline script
findings.description: bird-enrichment-guide: 528,740 bytes, 441,984 of inline JS; TTFB-to-complete 1.8-3.1 s. Likely whole data set embedded per page.
findings.recommendation: Move shared JS to a cached external file and load calculator data per tool; expected to cut HTML by 80%+ and improve LCP/INP.

findings.title: Homepage 26 images, field-data not measured
findings.recommendation: Connect Search Console and run PageSpeed on top templates.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Explicit allow rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended

findings.title: CCBot blocked
findings.description: Intentional; reduces Common Crawl-fed model exposure.

findings.title: llms.txt covers only about 6 tools of 308
findings.description: Does not list category hubs thoroughly.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All 26 homepage images have alt text

findings.title: Lazy loading not detected on sampled pages
findings.description: 0 loading=lazy found on bird guide (0 img tags in server HTML; images may be injected by JS).
findings.recommendation: Confirm images render in HTML for crawlers; add width/height and loading=lazy below fold.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Externalise/trim inline JS on tool template
